newsitem.title: USA: Stocks lost more ground as bond interest rates again rise.
newsitem.headline: Stocks lost more ground as bond interest rates again rise.

text.p: Stock prices closed lower Thursday as Wall Street's nerves were again rattled by another rise in long-term bond interest rates ahead of next week's meeting of the policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 35.74 points lower at 7,654.24 following Wednesday's 68-point drop.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on heavy volume of 503 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
